The House Committee on Regulated Industries offers Bill 892 (COMMITTEE SUBSTITUTE) By: Representatives Holcomb of the following substitute to HB 892: 101st, Buckner of the 137th, Miller of the 62nd, Evans of the 57th, and Barrett of the 24th
A BILL TO BE ENTITLED AN ACT
To amend Article 1 of Chapter 24A of Title 43 of the Official Code of Georgia Annotated, relating to massage therapy practice generally, so as to prohibit massage therapy businesses from … chapter for any person or entity to open for business or otherwise operate a massage therapy business between 10:00 P.M. and 6:00 A.M."
SECTION 3. All laws and parts of laws in conflict with this Act are repealed.
